notes.subject: feat(cli): add web_fetch and web_search, shared with the Assistant
notes.summary: The CLI gains web_fetch (public sites only) and web_search (Codex hosted search, or a SearXNG server set in web.searxngUrl). Shared web tools and readable-HTML helpers are now exported from the SDK packages, and the Assistant uses them with its network presets unchanged.
